Rina Khatri: opened PR 1932 to migrate the quota/usage dashboard links and add a Rust SDK snippet that demonstrates safe quota parsing + cost calculator integration: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1932. The dashboard refactor changed panel slugs and we need to update several cross-doc links.
Owen Mills: thanks — can you include a brief note about the billing unit change (embeddings now billed per 1k tokens) in the cost calc example? support keeps seeing customers confused by per-call math.
Rina Khatri: yep, updated the worked example. I also added a tiny Rust helper `safe_quota_from_headers` and wired the output into the billing calc. Snippet: ```rust
use reqwest::blocking::Client;
use std::collections::HashMap;
fn safe_quota_from_headers(h: &reqwest::header::HeaderMap) -> i64 {
    h.get("X-Quota-Remaining")
     .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())
     .and_then(|s| s.parse::<i64>().ok())
     .unwrap_or(-1) // -1 = unknown
}
fn main(){
    let client = Client::new();
    let resp = client.get("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage").send().unwrap();
    let q = safe_quota_from_headers(resp.headers());
    println!("quota_left={}", q);
}
```
